description_en: Queries MCP Servers in a specified workspace by paging. You can filter results by name, ready status, and service type
description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 MCP Server，可按名称、就绪状态和服务类型筛选
name: ListDataAgentMcp

parameters.help_en: The Data Agent workspace ID. The caller must have at least MEMBER permissions on this workspace
parameters.help_zh: Data Agent 工作空间 ID。调用者至少需要该工作空间的 MEMBER 权限
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword for name search. The server performs a fuzzy match against MCP Server names
parameters.help_zh: 名称搜索关键字。服务端按 MCP Server 名称进行模糊匹配
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值范围为 1～500，默认值为 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only MCP Servers that are enabled and in the ready state. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅返回已启用且状态为 ready 的 MCP Server。默认值为 false
parameters.name: ready_only

parameters.help_en: A compatible pagination parameter. The actual number of records per page is controlled by PageSize
parameters.help_zh: 兼容分页参数。当前服务端实际每页条数由 PageSize 控制
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A compatible pagination token. The actual page sequence is controlled by PageNumber
parameters.help_zh: 兼容续页标记。当前服务端实际页序由 PageNumber 控制
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The MCP Server type. Valid values:
system: system MCP.
customer: custom MCP
parameters.help_zh: MCP Server 类型。取值：system 表示系统 MCP；customer 表示自定义 MCP
parameters.name: type

Data.description_en: The paging query results of MCP Servers
Data.description_zh: MCP Server 分页查询结果

Content.description_en: The list of MCP Servers on the current page. Each item contains information such as the service identifier, name, workspace, network, connection method, status, and enabled state
Content.description_zh: 当前页的 MCP Server 列表；每项包含服务标识、名称、工作空间、网络、连接方式、状态和启用状态等信息

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, starting from 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page

TotalElements.description_en: The total number of records that match the filter conditions
TotalElements.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的记录总数

TotalPages.description_en: The total number of pages that match the filter conditions
TotalPages.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的总页数

ErrorCode.description_en: The return code. The value is success if the request was successful, or an error code if the request failed
ErrorCode.description_zh: 返回码。请求成功时为 success；请求失败时为对应的错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when a system-level request failure occurs
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 系统级请求失败时返回的错误信息

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records returned in this response
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次响应对应的最大返回条数

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. This value is empty when no more results are available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页标记；无更多结果时为空

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次调用

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh: 请求处理是否成功。取值为 true 表示成功，取值为 false 表示失败
